operations.title: Read bytes

fields.label: Byte offset (exact decimal)
fields.help: Decimal text so offsets above 2^53 survive the browser; at most 4 TiB.

fields.label: Byte length (exact decimal)
fields.help: At most 1 MiB per read; the result carries the chunk as base64 with its SHA-256.

operations.notes: Round-tripped by tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_operations_postgresql.py (dialog draft -> validate -> plan -> apply on a live PostgreSQL 16.15 server, effect observed). Not PostgreSQL 18.3 evidence: the profile pins 18.3, this host has 16.

operations.title: Write bytes

fields.label: Byte offset (exact decimal)
fields.help: Decimal text so offsets above 2^53 survive the browser; at most 4 TiB.

fields.label: Binary chunk
fields.help: Canonical base64, at most 1 MiB per reviewed chunk. The write is verified by a SHA-256 read-back before the transaction commits.

operations.notes: Round-tripped by tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_operations_postgresql.py (dialog draft -> validate -> plan -> apply on a live PostgreSQL 16.15 server, effect observed). Not PostgreSQL 18.3 evidence: the profile pins 18.3, this host has 16.

operations.title: Truncate to length

fields.label: New length in bytes (exact decimal)
fields.help: Bytes beyond this length are discarded; a longer length extends the object with zero bytes.

operations.notes: Round-tripped by tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_operations_postgresql.py (dialog draft -> validate -> plan -> apply on a live PostgreSQL 16.15 server, effect observed). operations.title: Import file from database server

fields.label: Source file on database server
fields.help: The path belongs to the database server host; server file privileges and operating-system access apply.

operations.notes: Round-tripped by tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_operations_postgresql.py (dialog draft -> validate -> plan -> apply on a live PostgreSQL 16.15 server, effect observed). Not PostgreSQL 18.3 evidence: the profile pins 18.3, this host has 16. Creates a large object from a server-side file, so it has no existing target; it is kept as a data-transfer action rather than the tier-1 create.

operations.title: Export to file on database server

fields.label: Destination file on database server (an existing file is overwritten)
fields.help: The path belongs to the database server host; SQL rollback cannot undo the file it writes.

fields.label: Type the exact server destination path
fields.help: Must equal the destination path above.

operations.notes: Round-tripped by tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_operations_postgresql.py (dialog draft -> validate -> plan -> apply on a live PostgreSQL 16.15 server, effect observed). Not PostgreSQL 18.3 evidence: the profile pins 18.3, this host has 16. The typed value is the destination path, not the target name, so it is an ordinary required field (as the Firebird confirm-type operations do), not typed_name.
